div.p: The one that catches everyone: the issuer must be the same name for the browser and for the container.
If the container reaches Keycloak as http://keycloak:8080 and the browser uses http://localhost:8080, the token's iss will not match and every login fails at the last step.
Use one DNS name that resolves for both.
QGIS_DESKTOP_AUTH_MODE=oidc ..._ISSUER_URL ← realm ..._CLIENT_ID ← client ..._CLIENT_SECRET ← secret ..._REDIRECT_URL ← redirect URI ..._ALLOWED_ROLES ← role
